Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most loved styles for everyday wear are the 460 The Perfect Neckline Bra and the 457 The Comfort Shaping Bra. 💕
The 460 The Perfect Neckline Bra ($51) features a plunging V-neckline, sewn-in foam padding, and our wire-free CradleLift™ architecture for smooth, natural lift without digging in. It is fantastic if you want lightweight coverage under low-cut tops.
The 457 The Comfort Shaping Bra ($34) focuses on maximum all-day ease with extra separation and support built into the inner band. It is a wonderful choice if you want maximum comfort and value for everyday wear!
